caption: The drawing depicts a single glass candlestick holder centered on a plain, light beige background. The candlestick holder is transparent, with light grey and white shading used to convey reflections and the three-dimensional form of the object. The holder has a wide, circular upper rim that tapers into a cylindrical neck, which then transitions into a thicker midsection with multiple facets. Below the midsection, the base flares out into a broad, four-sided platform with rounded edges, creating a stable support for the object. The entire candlestick holder is rendered with smooth, even lines and careful gradations of tone to represent its glassy, reflective surface. There is a small, handwritten signature in the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Candlestick
